assertions.title: Switcher lists all workspaces from /api/workspaces
test_names: displays all workspace names, paths, and repo counts
assertions.notes: Test opens switcher via mocked /api/workspaces, asserts 3 [data-workspace-item] rows, names (alpha, beta, gamma), paths (/workspaces/alpha, /workspaces/beta, /workspaces/gamma), and repo counts (3 repos, 1 repo, 2 repos) are all rendered.

assertions.title: Switcher marks current workspace with checkmark
test_names: shows active indicator (checkmark) for current workspace
assertions.notes: Test asserts items.nth(0) contains ✓ and items.nth(1)/.nth(2) do not contain ✓.

assertions.title: Clicking workspace row triggers switch
test_names: clicking a workspace item selects it and closes dialog
assertions.notes: Clicks items.nth(1) (beta), asserts dialog not visible and URL waits for **/ws/ws-beta/**.

assertions.title: Keyboard navigation — Arrow Down cycles through workspaces
test_names: ArrowDown moves highlight to next item
ArrowDown wraps from last to first
assertions.notes: Primary test presses ArrowDown then Enter, waits for /ws/ws-beta/. The wrap test extends coverage by verifying 3 ArrowDown presses wrap back to alpha.

assertions.title: Keyboard navigation — Arrow Up cycles backward
test_names: ArrowUp moves highlight to previous item
ArrowUp wraps from first to last
assertions.notes: Primary test presses ArrowDown twice then ArrowUp then Enter, verifies beta selected. Wrap test verifies ArrowUp from index 0 wraps to gamma.

assertions.title: Keyboard navigation — Enter selects highlighted workspace
test_names: Enter selects the highlighted workspace
assertions.notes: Test presses Enter on default (index 0) highlight and verifies navigation to /ws/ws-alpha/. Enter-on-empty-results test also covers the no-op edge case.

assertions.title: Escape key closes switcher
test_names: Escape closes the switcher
assertions.notes: Test presses Escape, asserts dialog not visible and URL unchanged from capture before Escape.

assertions.title: Search filter — substring match on workspace name
test_names: filters workspaces by name substring
search is case-insensitive
assertions.notes: Primary test fills search with a name fragment and verifies only matching rows remain. Case-insensitive variant strengthens coverage.

assertions.title: Search filter — substring match on workspace path
test_names: filters workspaces by path substring
assertions.notes: Test fills search with '/workspaces/gamma' and verifies only the gamma row remains.

assertions.title: Empty search result state
test_names: shows 'No workspaces found' when nothing matches
assertions.notes: Test fills search with 'nonexistent' and asserts 0 workspace items + 'No workspaces found' message visible.

assertions.title: Search clears when switcher reopens
test_names: reopening resets search term
assertions.notes: Test types 'beta', verifies 1 row; closes via Escape; reopens; asserts search input empty and all 3 rows visible.

assertions.title: Keyboard shortcut hints visible (first 9 workspaces)
test_names: shows shortcut hints for first 9 workspaces
assertions.notes: Test asserts Ctrl+Shift+1, Ctrl+Shift+2, Ctrl+Shift+3 labels are visible for the 3 mock workspaces. Covers the rendering convention; not the 9-item ceiling explicitly.

assertions.title: 100+ workspaces — dropdown scrollable
test_names: works with a single workspace
assertions.notes: Edge-case tests exist (e.g. single-workspace fixture, keyboard nav after filtering) but no test renders 100+ workspaces to verify the scrollable container overflow behavior. CSS declares max-height + overflow but no assertion in a spec proves scrollability at scale.

assertions.title: Clicking overlay backdrop closes switcher
test_names: clicking the overlay backdrop closes without selecting
assertions.notes: Test clicks at mouse coord (5,5) outside the dialog surface, asserts dialog not visible and URL unchanged.

assertions.title: Focus trap active while switcher open
test_names: auto-focuses search input on open
WorkspaceSwitcher: ArrowDown/ArrowUp navigate highlighted items, Enter selects
assertions.notes: Auto-focus of the search input is covered. keyboard-focus-management.spec.ts exercises arrow navigation while switcher is open but no test verifies Tab cycling is trapped inside the switcher (i.e. Tab at the last element returns to the first rather than escaping to the page).

assertions.title: Highlighted item scrolls into view
assertions.notes: No spec renders enough workspaces to force the scroll container to overflow and then verifies the highlighted row scrolls into view. Cannot be exercised with the current 3-workspace fixture.

assertions.title: Tree collapses and expands via toggle button
test_names: toggle button collapses sidebar
toggle button expands sidebar
collapsed sidebar shows badge with agent count
assertions.notes: Tests exercise the WorkspaceTree sidebar toggle: click collapses (data-collapsed=true, Agents text hidden), second click expands, and a collapsed badge renders agent count. Missing: assertion that state is persisted to localStorage key loom:{wsId}:tree-collapsed across reloads.

assertions.title: Tree shows repo list with health badges
test_names: workspace with health colors
multi workspace with agents
single workspace
assertions.notes: Visual regression screenshots render the WorkspaceTree with multi-repo fixtures and health-colored agents, implicitly verifying the repo list layout. Missing: explicit non-screenshot assertions that each repo row renders the repo name text and an agent-count / health badge.

assertions.title: Agent list in expanded tree
test_names: agent section shows with Agents header and count
agent cards render for each agent
agent card renders status and metadata
agent card shows role label
working agent shows Working status label
ready agent shows Ready status label
assertions.notes: Tests render the expanded sidebar (WorkspaceTree aside) with multiple agents and assert the Agents header + count, per-agent cards with [data-status], status labels (Working/Ready), role labels (Task/Plan), and repo metadata (loomcli).

assertions.title: Add workspace button triggers modal
test_names: clicking '+ New Workspace' opens the modal
modal has dialog role, aria-modal, and aria-label
modal title shows 'Create Workspace'
assertions.notes: Test clicks the New Workspace control and asserts the Create Workspace dialog becomes visible; companion tests verify ARIA attributes and title on the opened modal.

assertions.title: WorkspaceLayout validates workspace ID
test_names: shows Cortex when workspace API returns error
assertions.notes: Covers non-404 backend error (500) — WorkspaceLayout passes it through and falls back to 'Cortex'. But the contract assertion is specifically about an invalid workspace ID (404-equivalent) that should surface a boot error, which no test exercises.

assertions.title: WorkspacePage renders only if multi-repo workspace
assertions.notes: No spec navigates to the WorkspacePage for a single-repo workspace and asserts the guard redirects or hides the page. journey-workspace-lifecycle.spec.ts tests a general workspace route but not the multi-repo gating.

assertions.title: Modal opens with name field focused
test_names: name input auto-focuses when modal opens
assertions.notes: Test opens modal and asserts create-workspace-name input is focused.

assertions.title: Type selector shows three cards
test_names: Clone type is selected by default
Local Repos type shows Repository Paths field instead
Template radio is disabled
assertions.notes: Three tests collectively exercise all three type cards: clone (checked by default + shows clone-url input), empty (shows repo-path input), template (disabled). Together they satisfy the 'three cards visible and distinct' assertion.

assertions.title: Clone type requires repository URL
test_names: submit disabled when clone type and no URLs added
submit enabled with name + pending URL text
submit enabled when name filled and URLs added
assertions.notes: Submit is disabled with name only (no URL); enabled after filling pending URL or adding a URL chip. Demonstrates the URL requirement for clone type.

assertions.title: Add multiple clone URLs
test_names: typing URL and clicking Add creates a chip
pressing Enter in URL field adds chip
chip has remove button that removes it
duplicate URLs are not added
assertions.notes: Tests cover both Add-button and Enter-key paths to accumulate chips; removal and de-duplication behaviors are also covered.

assertions.title: Empty type shows repo paths input
test_names: Local Repos type shows Repository Paths field instead
type path and Add creates a chip
assertions.notes: Clicking empty type hides clone-url input and surfaces create-workspace-repo-path input; chip behaviour for repo paths is also exercised.

assertions.title: Template type shows coming soon placeholder
test_names: Template radio is disabled
assertions.notes: Template radio asserted disabled, matching the coming-soon placeholder contract.

assertions.title: Name field validates non-empty
test_names: submit disabled when name is empty
assertions.notes: Test asserts submit button is disabled when name is empty on initial modal open.

assertions.title: Location (path) field is optional
test_names: submits with correct body
Location placeholder updates dynamically with name
custom path sent when Location field filled
assertions.notes: 'submits with correct body' test omits the path field and verifies POST body contains only {name, type, clone_urls} — implicitly exercising optional semantics. Companion tests verify the placeholder updates and that a filled path is included in the body. No explicit assertion names 'path optional' as its primary behavior.

assertions.title: Submit form calls createWorkspace API
test_names: submits with correct body
modal closes on success
pending URL auto-added on submit
submit shows 'Creating...' and disables form during submission
assertions.notes: Tests intercept POST /api/workspaces, verify body shape {name, type, clone_urls}, modal closes on success, pending URL is added before submit, and the loading state is rendered during async submit.

assertions.title: Escape key closes modal (not during async job)
test_names: Escape key closes modal
clicking overlay closes modal
assertions.notes: Escape press dismisses the Create Workspace modal; overlay-click and Cancel paths reinforce dismiss behavior. keyboard-escape-layers.spec.ts verifies layer priority so Escape doesn't double-fire when other overlays are open.

assertions.title: Cancel button closes modal
test_names: Cancel button closes modal
assertions.notes: Test clicks the Cancel button and asserts the overlay is no longer visible.

assertions.title: RepoBadge displays repo name with deterministic color
test_names: dot has a background color
shows workspace name with dot and separator
clicking trigger opens dropdown with repo checkboxes
assertions.notes: workspace-breadcrumb.spec.ts verifies the multi-repo dot renders with inline background style. repo-selector.spec.ts verifies the repo checkboxes each surface repo names (frontend/backend/shared). Together they cover badge presence + color styling and name rendering.

assertions.title: RepoBadge uses dark text for contrast
test_names: dot has a background color
assertions.notes: Test asserts the dot has a background color but does NOT assert the text color is dark or verify WCAG contrast. repo-selector.spec.ts displays repo names but doesn't check color/contrast on the label.

assertions.title: RepoSelector hidden if <2 repos
test_names: not visible when workspace has only 1 repo
visible when workspace has 2+ repos
assertions.notes: Pair of tests confirms repo-filter-trigger is not visible with a single-repo workspace and is visible with multi-repo fixture.

assertions.title: Empty state when zero issues in workspace
assertions.notes: No Playwright spec mocks a workspace with zero issues and verifies the empty state component (headline, icon, subtitle) renders.

assertions.title: Empty state for single-repo workspace
assertions.notes: No spec asserts the single-repo empty state rendering explicitly. The repo-selector test confirms the filter is hidden for a single-repo workspace but does not verify any zero-issue empty state message.

assertions.title: Root / fetches workspace list
assertions.notes: No spec navigates to / and asserts a workspace list fetch occurs before redirect resolution. Existing specs navigate directly to /ws/{id} as their setup step.

assertions.title: Uses localStorage last workspace ID if valid
assertions.notes: No spec seeds loom:last-workspace-id in localStorage, navigates to /, and asserts redirect to that stored ID.

assertions.title: Falls back to default workspace if stored ID is stale
assertions.notes: No spec seeds a stale loom:last-workspace-id and verifies fallback to the default workspace via /api/workspaces/active.

assertions.title: Deep link to specific workspace /ws/{id} works
test_names: navigating to workspace B via URL shows workspace B data
displays workspace name from API response
assertions.notes: Multi-workspace monitoring spec does navigate to /ws/{id} and verifies workspace B data is shown, which implicitly covers deep link loading. But no dedicated test isolates 'deep link → correct workspace loaded' as its primary assertion against the canonical URL shape; most specs use /ws/{id} as a setup step rather than an assertion target.

assertions.title: Deep link to invalid workspace shows boot error
assertions.notes: No spec navigates to /ws/{invalid-id}/ and asserts a boot-error UI is surfaced rather than a silent redirect or blank page. Closely related to VAL-FE-WS-041 partial coverage.

assertions.title: URL updates on workspace switch
test_names: clicking a workspace item selects it and closes dialog
ArrowDown moves highlight to next item
Enter selects the highlighted workspace
Ctrl+K opens switcher, search filters, Enter switches workspace
navigating to workspace B via URL shows workspace B data
assertions.notes: Multiple switcher tests assert page.waitForURL(**/ws/{new-id}/**) after click / ArrowDown+Enter / Ctrl+K+search+Enter, covering the core 'URL updates to the new workspace ID' contract across interaction modes. multi-workspace-monitoring.spec.ts additionally verifies URL-driven navigation renders workspace B data.

assertions.title: URL segments preserved or reset on switch
assertions.notes: No spec switches workspaces while on a non-default view (e.g. ?view=table, issue panel open) and asserts whether view/query segments are preserved or reset in the post-switch URL.

assertions.title: Back button returns to previous workspace
assertions.notes: No spec switches workspaces and then invokes page.goBack() to verify browser history restores the previous workspace URL and data.
